title: Developing a Subdistrict-Level Economic Progress Index Using Geospatial Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.23798v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops an Economic Progress Index (EPI), a composite measure built from Earth Observation (EO) and open geospatial data with unsupervised Principal Component Analysis (PCA) weighting. The index captures the observable productive and enabling capacity of local economies and the intensity with which economic space is used. Sub-national monitoring in developing economies is held back by sparse data: district GDP estimates arrive with multi-year lags, rely on price deflators and top-down allocation, and do not exist at the subdistrict (taluka/tehsil) scale where place-based policy is targeted. The EPI fuses multi-sensor satellite data, gridded population and OpenStreetMap road and amenity networks across 357 subdistricts of Maharashtra, India, over 46 quarters (2015 Q1 - 2026 Q2). translated_title: 利用地理空间数据构建次区级经济进步指数
translated_abstract: 本文开发了经济进步指数（EPI），这是一个基于地球观测（EO）数据和开放地理空间数据、采用无监督主成分分析（PCA）加权的综合指标。该指数捕捉了地方经济可观测的生产能力与支撑能力，以及经济空间的使用强度。发展中经济体的次国家级监测一直受到数据稀缺的制约：区级GDP估算数据滞后多年，依赖价格平减指数和自上而下的分配方式，并且在地方性政策所针对的次区（塔鲁克/特西尔）尺度上根本不存在此类数据。EPI融合了多传感器卫星数据、网格化人口数据以及OpenStreetMap道路与设施网络数据，覆盖印度马哈拉施特拉邦357个次区，时间跨度为46个季度（2015年第一季度至2026年第二季度）。基于LOESS的季节-趋势分解（STL）方法将长期趋势与季风和作物周期的季节性波动相分离。非负PCA给出了符号一致的……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 本文利用地球观测和开放地理空间数据，通过无监督PCA加权构建了经济进步指数（EPI），为印度马哈拉施特拉邦357个次区提供了以往不存在的次区级经济发展监测工具。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an Economic Progress Index (EPI) from Earth Observation and open geospatial data with unsupervised PCA weighting, providing subdistrict-level economic monitoring across 357 subdistricts of Maharashtra, India, where such data previously did not exist.
